criteria.operational_permission: Only seal.operational_native_id==arms.native_real; exact external COMMITTED contract after actual adoption. Controls cannot become principal; no preparation/reset on selected life. Six future opportunities are explicit finite supply, not evaluated positives.
criteria.operational: All inherited metadata literal, exact requests/terminal receipts, immutable sample provenance, actual query2/actuator/FI/message/products, coherent save/reopen
criteria.candidate_floor: Root CRITERIOS_PI09_R01.json remains the adoption authority: minimum8/12 useful and4/6 reserved, with its conservation/integrity requirements
criteria.content_value: Actual difference in later Native choice and/or physical outcome in always-real vs fixed desynchronized material reference, with request/release/time/dose differences enumerated
criteria.selection: Describe actual query1 Native RAW choices separately from forced material reference motors and from applied requests. Never use nominal cue as measured perception.
criteria.learning_scope: One shared bank; first trace has no established generic return. Do not infer acquired value of asking or query-specific credit from a changed first choice.
criteria.phase_transfer: Use actual calendars, input IDs and physical samples, not nominal waits alone; preserve development and six reserved denominators separately
criteria.negative: NULL/known functional conflict remains scientific; unknown transport/pending/safety stops preserve the future without retry/reset

scope: Prepared serial two-query access with Native choices and causal content controls. External transducer register is not Native sensor memory. No general curiosity, learned sequence, autonomous query initiation or exclusive credit to asking is asserted.
